strings.name: Yuri Gagarin
strings.summary: Yuri Gagarin was a Soviet pilot and cosmonaut. On 12 April 1961, he orbited Earth aboard Vostok 1, becoming the first human in space and opening the era of human spaceflight. He subsequently undertook international visits and cosmonaut training duties while continuing his studies in aeronautical engineering. He died in 1968 during a flight in a two-seat training aircraft, leaving a landmark achievement in the history of space exploration.

strings.facts.fact-01.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.fact-01.value: Klushino, Soviet Union, now in Russia
strings.facts.fact-02.label: Education and training
strings.facts.fact-02.value: Orenburg military flying school; Zhukovsky Air Force Engineering Academy
strings.facts.fact-03.label: Space mission
strings.highlights.highlight-01.title: First human in space
strings.highlights.highlight-01.text: Orbited Earth once aboard Vostok 1 in 1961, completing the first crewed orbital flight.
strings.highlights.highlight-02.title: Training cosmonauts
strings.highlights.highlight-02.text: Worked at the training center after his flight, helping prepare subsequent cosmonauts for missions.
strings.timeline.event-01.title: Killed during a training flight
strings.timeline.event-01.text: Crashed while flying a MiG-15UTI trainer with instructor Vladimir Seryogin; he was 34.
strings.timeline.event-02.title: Completes engineering studies
strings.timeline.event-02.text: Completed technical studies and graduation research while continuing his work in cosmonaut training.
strings.timeline.event-03.title: Serves as backup for Soyuz 1
strings.timeline.event-03.text: Prepared as Vladimir Komarov’s backup crewmember, still hoping to return to space.
strings.timeline.event-04.title: Helps lead cosmonaut training
strings.timeline.event-04.text: Became a deputy at the Cosmonaut Training Center, taking responsibility for training later flight personnel.
strings.timeline.event-05.title: First human spaceflight
strings.timeline.event-05.text: Launched aboard Vostok 1, orbited Earth once and returned safely, marking a milestone in human spaceflight.
strings.timeline.event-06.title: Selected among the first cosmonauts
strings.timeline.event-06.text: Chosen from Soviet pilots for a group of twenty, undergoing endurance tests and flight-mission training.
strings.timeline.event-07.title: Completes military flight training
strings.timeline.event-07.text: Qualified as a pilot and joined the Soviet Air Force, continuing to gain experience flying jets.
strings.timeline.event-08.title: Enters military flying school
strings.timeline.event-08.text: After technical school, entered the military flying school in Orenburg for professional flight training.
strings.timeline.event-09.title: Born in Klushino
strings.timeline.event-09.text: Born into a rural Soviet family; later studied metalworking and technical subjects and became involved in flying.
